# Known Nightly flakes. The tag gate reads this file:
#     just check-nightly-gate <sha>     (just release-tag runs it)
# The rules are in tools/ci_gates.ts and in RELEASING.md step 5.
#
# One row per line, fields separated by "|":
#
#     job | run id | owner | added | expires | test
#
#   job      The Nightly job name as GitHub shows it, with its matrix value,
#            for example "RPC soak (chaos + deadlines, windows-latest)".
#   run id   The Nightly run that showed the flake. This is the evidence.
#   owner    The person who watches the flake and removes the row.
#   added    The date the row was added, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC).
#   expires  The last date the row is in force, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). It must
#            be 0 to 30 days after "added".
#   test     Optional. One name from a nightly-failure annotation of that
#            job: a test name, "<step id>: <soak reason>" (each number in
#            the reason is N) or "step:<step id>" (a failure with no test
#            name in that step). The test is the last field, so it can
#            contain "|".
#
# How a row covers a failed job:
#   - A failed job with nightly-failure annotations is covered only when
#     each of its annotations has a row in force with this job and that
#     test. A row with no test does not cover it.
#   - A failed job with no nightly-failure annotation is covered only by a
#     row in force with this job and no test.
#   - A row covers its job in every Nightly run while the row is in force,
#     not only in the run that it names.
#   - A job that has more failures than annotations
#     (nightly-failure-overflow) is never covered.
#
# Add a row only for a failure that is not caused by the commit: it does
# not occur again on the same commit, and the test or lane is known to be
# sensitive to timing or to the runner. Fix a real failure; do not add a
# row for it. When a row expires, remove it, or renew it with a new date
# and the id of a new run that shows the flake.
#
# Example (not a row):
#   Extended gates | 38713314813 | nullstyle | 2026-10-15 | 2026-10-29 | rpc_quic_peer_test.test.WarmRedialClient.requestStop never writes into a generation that ended on its own
#
# Lines that start with "#" are comments. Put the rows below this line.
